newsitem.title: FRANCE: France issues nine billion ffr in OATs to funds.
newsitem.headline: France issues nine billion ffr in OATs to funds.

text.p: The French Treasury said it was issuing nine billion francs of OATs to a special money market stabilisation fund.
The papers concerned are three billion francs nominal of the 8.5 percent 2008 OAT, three billion francs nominal of the 6.5 percent OAT 2011 and three billion francs of the 8.5 percent 2012 OAT.
This paper will never be the subject of "firm" sales but can be used for short-term loans with money market brokers in order to stabilise the market.
The issue will be effective from today.
